newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two bombs kill one, wound 33 in Algiers - Officials.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs kill one, wound 33 in Algiers - Officials.

text.p: Two bombs exploded on Sunday in Algiers killing one person and wounding 33 others, Algerian security forces said.
A car bomb exploded near Algiers' law university in Ben Aknoun district killing one and wounding 12, they said in a statement reported by the official Algerian news agency APS.
About two hours earlier, a home-made bomb went off near a disco in a park, some two kilometres (1.25 miles) away in the same district, wounding 21 people, the statement added.
The bombings came five days after a bomb explosion killed three schoolgirls and a 12-year-old boy outside a high school in central Algiers.
About 60,000 people have been killed in Algerian violence since early 1992 when authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a huge lead.
